title: The Station window: header, menus, tabs and panels
summary: The window has a header with the project, transport and shortcut buttons, a menu bar (File, Edit, View, Help), and a dock area where panels appear as tabs, side-by-side or floating.
alternateQueries: How do I reset the layout?
How do I move a panel?
Where are the buttons at the top?

blocks.text: At the top is the header. It shows the application name, the suite application icons, a Project button (the current project's name), a gear button for suite settings, and the buttons Audio, Assets, Pods, Tour, a ? button (about this application) and Sign In. Below them are the transport controls.
Under the header is the menu bar: File, Edit, View and Help. The File menu changes with the panel that has focus (see the menus reference).

Panels live in the dock area. Each panel has a tab. You can drag a tab to dock it beside another panel, drop it onto another panel's tab strip to make a tabbed group, or float it into its own window. The layout is remembered between sessions, including which panel was showing.
View > Reset Dock Layout puts every panel back in its default arrangement.
The header's status line ("Ready." when idle) reports what the application is doing and short results such as "New arrangement." or "Saved arrangement: <name>".
